invariants.rationale: A savepoint operation should refer to a specific instant; instantToSavepoint is likely required.
A savepoint should generally track the user performing the operation, so user is expected to be non-null.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is needed for the savepoint action to be executed; likely should not be null.
The comment provides context for the savepoint and may be required; null checks are prudent.
A valid instant identifier should be a non-empty string, ensuring a valid savepoint target.
